description: Check domains against the SURBL URI blacklist in bulk. URI blacklists list the domains that appear inside a message body, so a listed tracking or landing domain sends the whole email to spam however clean the sender is. Up to 100 domains per call. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.
name: check_surbl

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.
